prompts.name: tiki-pillar
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: isolated production videogame prop reference for image-to-3D.
Primary request: a single tall ancient squared carved tiki sandstone pillar, about 3 metres wide, 9 metres tall and 3 metres deep, for a lush tropical temple platformer.
Scene/backdrop: pure neutral white studio background with only a subtle contact shadow. One object, completely isolated, no surrounding scene.
Subject: tall squared monolithic pillar made from broad rounded stacked masonry sections; a handmade stylized grinning tiki face carved as deep broad geometric relief across its front; weighty projecting brow, flattened nose, mouth and chin, clear deep dark seams; uneven broken stepped top, a little restrained emerald moss on horizontal ledges, a few short dark roots curled close to the stone around its lower sides. Keep its straight upright architectural silhouette legible.
Style/medium: exceptionally polished stylized high-quality videogame prop; handmade tropical temple art in the visual spirit of Crash Bandicoot N. Sane Trilogy, chunky appealing forms and painterly material color. Smooth generous bevels, rich readable relief, no noisy tiny sculpture detail.
Composition/framing: 3/4 orthographic view showing front and right side; entire tall prop in frame with generous white margin. Stable upright vertical axis and level horizon.
Lighting/mood: soft neutral studio illumination, broad highlights describing stone curvature and the carved relief, deep natural crevice occlusion.
Color palette: warm ochre golden sandstone, soft muted terracotta variations, deep chocolate-brown recesses, restrained emerald moss.
Materials/textures: smooth worn sandstone, coarse large crack breaks, very sparse broad stains; no photographic speckling.
Constraints: one solid reusable modular pillar only; enough thickness to be physically credible; no people, animals, weapons, scenery, floor slab, platforms, scale rulers, labels, text, watermarks or logos. Preserve iconic broad sculpted silhouette.

prompts.name: temple-lintel
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: isolated reusable production videogame architectural prop reference for image-to-3D.
Primary request: a single enormous ruined tropical temple lintel gateway formed only from TWO thick upright outer posts and ONE straight horizontal stone lintel across the top, with a completely clear wide rectangular opening underneath.
Scene/backdrop: pure neutral white studio background with a subtle contact shadow. One isolated object, no surrounding environment.
Subject: ancient U-shaped squared portal about 18 metres wide, 13 metres tall and 5 metres deep, its central opening at least 12 metres wide and 8 metres tall. Opening must occupy approximately 65% of total width and 65% of total height. Straight upright columns at the extreme outer left and right; broad flat underside of the high horizontal lintel. The empty white space below the beam is entirely open and large enough for a wide 12-metre road and a videogame camera to pass underneath. Heavy but thin lintel band built from enormous coarse rounded stacked warm sandstone blocks, carved shallow stepped geometric frieze along its upper face, subtle tiki motifs contained entirely inside the top band. Broken corners and uneven top silhouette suggest ancient ruins, but the overall gateway stands stable. A little restrained emerald moss on upper ledges and a few short vines close to the outer stone surfaces.
Style/medium: exceptionally polished handmade stylized tropical temple videogame prop in the visual spirit of Crash Bandicoot N. Sane Trilogy; chunky smooth broad shapes, generous bevels, painted ochre stone, expressive simple carved geometry and dark deep seams, economical readable detail.
Composition/framing: 3/4 orthographic view with mostly frontal angle so the entire huge rectangular empty opening is clearly visible; show front and right depth, full structure within frame with generous white margin. Level horizon and vertical posts.
Lighting/mood: neutral soft studio illumination, broad highlights and rich crevice occlusion.
Color palette: warm ochre golden sandstone with restrained warm terracotta variants, deep chocolate-brown crevices, restrained emerald moss.
Materials/textures: broad smooth worn sandstone, large hand-shaped block edges, sparse broad staining, avoid fine noisy grain.
Constraints: a single modular U-shaped gate only, freestanding posts plus lintel; NO doors, NO floor, NO threshold, NO stone connection along bottom, NO stairs, NO road, NO columns inside the passage, NO central support, NO low arch, NO keystone or tiki face hanging into the opening. Keep the rectangular aperture completely clear, with enormous safe overhead clearance. No people, vegetation clumps, scenery, surrounding walls, scale rulers, labels, text, watermarks or logos.

prompts.name: red-foliage
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: isolated production videogame foliage prop reference for image-to-3D.
Primary request: one lush low compact tropical fern and banana-leaf clump with a few coral-red tropical leaves, approximately 3 metres wide, 1.4 metres tall and 3 metres deep, to accent a warm sandstone temple canyon platformer.
Scene/backdrop: pure neutral white studio background with a subtle contact shadow. Completely isolated single foliage tuft, no scene.
Subject: a dense low spreading mound of broad curved lush banana-like leaves and elegant feathered fern fronds, grouped tightly into one coherent reusable foliage clump. Clear appealing tuft silhouette, gently arching blades toward the outside and slightly taller central leaves, with a handful of rich coral-red and warm burgundy tropical leaves mixed naturally among the green. The red accents occupy around one fifth of the visible plant and provide strong readable color spots, rather than flowers. Short hidden stems only and a compact dark root core contained beneath the foliage; no trunk.
Style/medium: exceptionally polished stylized videogame prop; handmade tropical jungle art in the visual spirit of Crash Bandicoot N. Sane Trilogy; smooth chunky sculpted leaves with gently exaggerated curvature, rich painterly greens, simple clear veins, broad shapes readable at gameplay distance.
Composition/framing: 3/4 orthographic view from slightly above, showing the complete compact clump with generous white margins; foliage spread horizontally wider than tall. One single coherent cluster, no separate plants.
Lighting/mood: soft neutral studio lighting with pleasing broad highlights and deep green core shadows; rich dimensional leaf layering.
Color palette: emerald, fern green, yellow-green broad edge highlights, rich coral-red and a few burgundy leaves; natural dark brown hidden core.
Materials/textures: smooth stylized matte leaves with bold central veins and softly painterly color gradients, avoid photorealistic noise.
Constraints: broad enough leaves for efficient 3D geometry, low rounded tuft only, no tree, no trunk, no tall stalks, no palms, no flowers, no pot, no soil mound, no ground plane, no rocks, no temple pieces, no environment, no people, no labels, no text, no watermarks or logos. Preserve highly legible compact decorative silhouette.
